author: RIP_Avicus
body:
Hey guys, I was playing today and I had an idea.
If any of you have ever played Survival Games Hypixel (I think) you will know that they have health bars above players.
I thought that this was a pretty good idea, but lag could be greatly increased by introducing it.
Feedback would be really appreciated! :D

title: Health Bars?

replies.author: SWEET_Johny
replies.body: Eh, kinda takes away from the PvP aspect, as it can alter it in certain ways. I enjoy PvPing without health bars, it's more fun and strategic.
replies.body_tagged: Eh, kinda takes away from the PvP aspect, as it can alter it in certain ways. I enjoy PvPing without health bars, it's more fun and strategic.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body: Well "Damage Indicators" mod is not permitted for use on the Avicus Network, so why would we have a health bar above a player? It's the same thing.
replies.body_tagged: Well "Damage Indicators" mod is not permitted for use on the Avicus Network, so why would we have a health bar above a player? It's the same thing.
